name: Ahead Innovation Labs
website_summary: Ahead Innovation Labs sells a generative simulation platform that creates synthetic market price paths to help institutional investors, portfolio managers, and quant teams stress-test strategies against scenarios not found in historical data. name: Aiera
website_summary: Aiera sells a permissioned AI platform that gives investment professionals compliant access to broker research, event transcripts, filings, expert insights, and financial news through APIs, dashboards, and Model Context Protocol integrations. It is built for buy-side and sell-side institutions that want to embed proprietary financial content into their AI workflows with full attribution and audit trails.
linkedin_summary: Aiera recently launched what it calls the industry's first sell-side-validated AI content delivery platform, backed by 11 major Wall Street banks including Bank of America, Barclays, Citi, and UBS, and published research showing its MCP server delivers a 2.4x average performance improvement on financial research tasks. The company also appointed Eric Lebovich as Head of Product Management and participated in events including BattleFin Discovery Day and Unbundling Uncovered NYC.
